description: Use this when the user asks for a client's statement of account, a client's invoices and payments over a period, or what a client owes with a running balance. A client's statement for a period, as in the statement in Fatura Go: their issued invoices dated in the period with payments, credit notes and write-offs, a running balance, and totals per currency (invoiced, paid, written off, outstanding, unused credit). brought_forward is separate: what is still unpaid today on earlier invoices (the statement itself starts at 0). Default period: 1 January this year to today. At most the last 100 lines per currency. app_url opens the client, where the user downloads or emails the statement. Do not use it for one invoice (get_invoice) or for all clients' balances (list_clients).

business_id.description: From list_businesses. May be left out when the connection shares exactly one business.

date_from.description: YYYY-MM-DD, document date on or after.

date_to.description: YYYY-MM-DD, document date on or before.

unpaid_only.description: Only invoices with something left to pay.
